title: Kinetic
offline: The wallpaper engine is not running. Start it with: systemctl --user start kinetic-wall
off: Off: Omarchy's own background is showing
noWallpaper: No wallpaper is showing. Turn it on with the switch above, or pick one in the Library.
restart: Start over: a new map, a fresh seed, a replanted garden
bar.notKinetic: The active bar is %1. The pill needs Kinetic's build of Omarchy's bar, which keeps every widget and setting you have.
bar.glass.wallpaper: Glass: the live wallpaper bends behind the pill.
bar.glass.blur: Glass: Hyprland blurs behind the pill.
looks.about: A look sets the wallpaper and the bar together. Click one to apply it.
hint: 1–2 tabs · / search · n/p next/prev · r random · space pause · o all settings
motion.on: Kinetic animates windows and workspaces, and the live wallpaper slides in step at its own depth.
motion.off: Off: Omarchy's own animations. Turn on, or pick a preset, to slide workspaces with wallpaper parallax.
offStill: Off: Omarchy's background, which Kinetic keeps drawing so the glass can bend it
openApp: Open Kinetic: the bar, glass, motion, looks and the engine
app.title: Kinetic
app.subtitle: Look and feel for Omarchy
app.keys: Ctrl + 1–9 or Ctrl + Tab: pages · Esc: close
app.wallpaper.about: What shows, its presets and parameters
app.library.about: Every live wallpaper, to pick from
app.bar.about: The pill: style, shape, spacing, shadow
app.glass.about: Glass under the bar and behind windows
app.looks.about: Wallpaper, bar and motion, saved together
glass.about: Glass bends the wallpaper behind the bar's capsules and behind windows, frosts it, splits its colors at the rim and catches the light. It needs pixels to bend: a live wallpaper, or Omarchy's own background, which Kinetic keeps drawing while the live wallpaper is off.
glass.barOff: The pill is off, so the bar has no glass. Turn the pill on under Bar.
glass.transparent: Window glass shows through windows that are see-through: Omarchy's glassy windows, or any window with opacity. See-through puts it only there (an opaque window would hide it anyway), and it opens, closes and moves with each window on Hyprland's own animation.
glass.masterOn: On: the wallpaper bends behind the bar and windows
glass.masterOff: Off: the bar uses Hyprland's blur, windows have no glass, and turning the wallpaper off hands the desktop back to Omarchy
glass.lookAbout: One look for the bar's glass and the windows' glass: each change sets both.
light.title: Selection light
app.light.about: A glow around windows, under the glass
modules.about: Every part of Kinetic, and the modules you added. Switch off what you don't use: it stops, and leaves the list on the left. Add a module from a GitHub link, a folder or an archive; Kinetic shows what it would install, and what that needs, before installing anything.
modules.wall.on: The engine is running. Glass, the light and wallpaper parallax need it.
modules.wall.off: Off: Omarchy's own background. The engine is stopped and starts again with the switch.
modules.bar.on: Kinetic's build of Omarchy's bar, with the pill.
modules.glass.on: Glass under the bar and behind windows.
modules.glass.off: Off: the bar uses Hyprland's blur, windows have no glass.
modules.motion.on: Kinetic's animations, pass-through and wallpaper parallax.
modules.look.off: Hidden: looks run nothing, so off only takes them out of the app.
modules.dropHint: Or drop a module folder, archive or link anywhere on this window.
modules.badSource: That is not a link, a folder or an archive.
modules.stopsToo: %1 need %2 and will stop with it.
